summary: Flat residential kerb where cars park, but homes sit 15 m back.
reasons: Homes 15-16 m away on own side

best_section.where: Kerb on the crest, about 40 m from the junction at the start

drivers.seclusion: Houses 15-16 m behind the kerb with front gardens, more homes across the road; no bush or open ground.
drivers.access_and_room: Wide kerbside lane; several cars parked along this kerb in the Esri image, so room to stop is fine.
drivers.traffic: Two-lane suburban road with a centre line; moderate through traffic likely.
drivers.convention: Cars parked on both sides in the imagery; no signs mapped; no campers seen.

flags: Steep either side of the crest: max grade about 14%, mean 5.6%
Mapped gates 220 m and 256 m away have a way round
sun_shade: Mostly open; street trees and a large tree near 40 m shade from the south-west.
